name: Harem Secrets
source: Harem Secrets begins with the protagonist returning from a trip to discover the death of his friend, unleashing a plot of mystery, lies, angels and romance. As he searches for the killer, he becomes embroiled in thrilling twists and turns, revealing dark secrets and deep connections with captivating characters. The romantic touch adds an engaging dimension, creating a thrilling experience that defies expectations.
translation: 《后宫秘辛》始于主角结束旅途归来，却惊闻好友惨死的消息——一场交织着悬疑、谎言、天使与浪漫恋情的阴谋就此揭开序幕。在追查真凶的过程中，他卷入了扣人心弦的层层反转，揭开黑暗秘密，并与魅力非凡的角色们建立起深厚羁绊。浪漫元素的融入为故事增添了迷人的维度，带来超乎想象的惊险体验。
